notes.title: Global update ZIC: Zombies In City now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Check out the new global update! And now we will tell you what awaits you.

[h3]PLAY WITH FRIENDS![/h3]
We've added a co-op mode — now you can join forces with your friends and fight against ruthless zombies together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34975851/1dd3e262469745de201b0e10185ce2dc64fe78fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34975851/b8a596fabffcc237a03908aa9ed8baaf356b633e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34975851/aafe415591c55ec3d3cfe0aaa0a1a49f34b92273.png[/img]

[h3]IMPROVED GRAPHICS![/h3]
We've tweaked the lighting and shadows to bring out the zombie apocalypse atmosphere even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34975851/4670c42546c5694b3d12f568f6d50c41034527ba.png[/img]

[h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3]
In addition to global novelties, we have fixed many old bugs and reworked the balance of weapons and zombies.

Have a nice game!
